name: LocalBiz AI
tagline: Autonomous WhatsApp AI Receptionist & Food Order Engine
description: Enterprise-grade WhatsApp AI business receptionist built for local restaurants, food chains, and retail stores. Features native Roman Urdu and English natural language understanding, real-time lead capture, automated Kitchen Order Ticket (KOT) generation, Groq Llama-3 and Google Gemini failover architecture, and human agent escalation.
